mail.confirm.body:
Hello {username},

someone requested an account for “{instanceTitle}” using this address.

If that was not you, there is nothing to do: without the link below nothing
happens at all, and the request expires by itself.

If it was you, confirm that the address is yours:
{link}

The link is valid for {hours} hours.
It opens no account and sets no password — it only says “yes, that is me”.
An admin decides on the request afterwards. If it is approved, you will get
a second email with the link for setting your password.

This message was sent automatically. Nobody reads replies to it.
mail.confirm.subject: Confirm your address for “{instanceTitle}”
mail.hintAlways: The sender address must belong to the account — GMX does not allow sending as someone else's address.
mail.hintGmail: Gmail requires two-factor and an app password — the account password is rejected.
mail.hintGmx: GMX requires you to enable sending from other programs in the account first.
mail.hintWebDe: Web.de requires you to enable sending from other programs in the account first.
mail.invite.body:
Hello {username},

an account for “{instanceTitle}” has been created for you.

Use this link to set your own password:
{link}

The link is valid for {days} days and exactly once.
From the first time you open it you have {minutes} minutes — you may reload as often as you like within that.
After that you need a new link from the admin.

Whoever has this link gets in — do not pass it on.

This message was sent automatically. Nobody reads replies to it.

Hello {username},

this is the test email from “{instanceTitle}”.

If it arrives, mail delivery works: invitations and reset links go out on
their own from now on. The link is still available for copying in the
admin area as well — that does not change.

This message was sent automatically. Nobody reads replies to it.
